sentence: This project studies how a protein that acts on histones has a role in RNA editing in prostate cancer.
This project combines two photoacoustic computed tomography prototypes into one imaging system to identify which breast cancer patients respond to neoadjuvant therapy.
This project studies how myeloid cells eat dead cells in the retina and whether this protects against retinal disease.
This project studies how epicardial cells send signals to heart muscle cells and how the extracellular matrix changes cell behavior in the developing heart.
This project studies genes on the X and Y chromosomes that differ between males and females, including how they work and affect gene activity.
This project tests whether calcium nanoparticles carrying an antibody raise calcium in dendritic cells and improve radio-immunotherapy against tumors.
This project maps DNA methylation changes found on only one copy of the genome in leukemia and tests whether they predict disease progression.
This project builds coursework on how artificial intelligence and machine learning are used in cancer research.
This project uses machine learning to combine electroencephalography and behavior measures into a marker that tells autistic from neurotypical children.
This project studies why people with osteogenesis imperfecta have lung problems, looking at abnormal extracellular matrix secretion and stress in lung cells.
This project builds machine learning methods that use microbiome data and clinical measures to predict ventilator-associated pneumonia earlier.
This project builds a sensing device that detects sepsis-causing pathogens directly from blood without a blood culture.
This project uses artificial intelligence and natural language processing on electronic health records to predict suicide risk in lonely, socially isolated older adults.
This project studies how neurons in the cochlea pass sensory information from hair cells to the brain in health and disease.
This project tries to find signs of natural selection in the human genome by using information about several evolutionary forces.
This project studies how voltage-gated sodium channels shape electrical signals in proprioceptors, the sensory neurons that sense limb position.
This project screens many chemicals to find and improve chemical probes for a therapeutic target, aiming at metabolic complications of HIV.
This project studies gene expression in single cells from brain regions in a small animal model of HIV that self-administers methamphetamine.
This project tries to find out how a protein senses double-stranded RNA from mitochondria in children with autoimmune Sjӧgren’s disease.
This project runs a shared imaging facility that supports research on how the nervous system works and develops.
